result.question: When a Unit changes its own ground/air identity, does the common transition clean up blocking, or is that cleanup owned by each specific effect?

pages.finding: Confirms current identity can differ from pathfinding and that levitation/ground binding use separate control mechanisms; does not specify which common transition callback releases blocking.
Distinguishes abnormal flags and state-machine effects; insufficient to assign common Layer-transition cleanup responsibility.

limits: Community descriptions do not prove exact client call ordering.
Conflicting or incomplete stacking descriptions are outside this targeted question.
